note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in the Tobermore division took place on Friday 2 June 1933; no other division was contested, twenty-five members being returned unopposed at the nominations on Friday 28 April 1933 (Irish News, 1 May 1933, p. 3). The list prints no divisions. Of the twenty-five, twenty-three are the members already matched to their divisions; the other two are the new members David W. Wallace and D. M'Clure (the place names after their names are their abodes: Mrs. Higgins, the third new member, is 'for Magherafelt Division'). The two divisions whose 1930 members are not in the 1933 list are Lissan Upper (W. J. Reid) and Salterstown (Robert Alexander Scott). Division inferred from the 2 June 1936 return (Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1936, p. 3), which has D. M'Clure for Salterstown; the Irish News (1 May 1933, p. 3) names the member as returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
